**ReproMut** is a controlled mutation benchmark for comparing reproducibility auditors on small machine-learning experiments.

Preprint: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24048006

## Downloads

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `repromut-*.whl` | Installable Python package: `pip install repromut-*.whl` |
| `repromut-*.tar.gz` | Source distribution |
| `repromut-preprint-*.pdf` | The preprint |
| `repromut-results-*.zip` | Raw benchmark results: the 452-case development run, plus the smoke run generated by this release build |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | Checksums for verifying the downloads |

## Quick start

```bash
pip install repromut-*.whl
repromut bench --smoke --out results/smoke
```

## Status

This is a development release. The results are exploratory and not yet from the preregistered confirmatory run. See `docs/limitations.md`.
